data.name: Spell Dance
data.description: The spell dancer gains the ability to expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to gain a +%1 enhancement bonus to his movement rate and a +%2 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through threatened spaces for 1 minute.|(1+(MagusLVL-1)/4)*10|(1+(MagusLVL-1)/4)*2

raw_tokens.value: The spell dancer gains the ability to expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to gain a +%1 enhancement bonus to his movement rate and a +%2 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through threatened spaces for 1 minute.|(1+(MagusLVL-1)/4)*10|(1+(MagusLVL-1)/4)*2
Once per spell dance as a swift action, the spell dancer may use one of the following on himself as a swift action: blur, fly, or haste. These abilities last for 1 round.|PRECLASS:1,Magus=5
The spell dancer may instead take a swift action to use dimension door as a spell-like ability once during a spelldance.|PRECLASS:1,Magus=9
The spell dancer may instead choose to take a swift action to gain freedom of movement for 1d4 rounds.|PRECLASS:1,Magus=13
